subject: Peter Lassally
headline: peter lassally, late-night producer, dies at 93
body: he produced the tonight show for johnny carson and the late show for david letterman, then the late late show with craig ferguson.
slide2: he got his start with arthur godfrey, spent 23 years on the tonight show, and helped engineer letterman's move to cbs. he had retired at 82.

subject: Kenneth Branagh
headline: kenneth branagh is going up against a billionaire
body: paramount+ ordered the scottish highland drama laird with him as the lead landowner.
slide2: it's from jez butterworth (mobland, the agency) and his brother john-henry, branagh's laird fights to keep a billionaire from buying up the glens.

subject: Ed Harris
headline: ed harris felt misled about his 'dutton ranch' role
body: he told variety he thought the part in the 'yellowstone' spinoff would matter more than it did.
slide2: "get me the f— out of here," he told his team halfway through filming season 1.
